summary: Custom Document Extractor can create schema labels automatically from pre-labeled documents.
extended_definition: Custom Document Extractor can create schema labels automatically from pre-labeled documents.

supporting_pages.title: Custom extractor mechanisms \_|\_ Document AI \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Custom extractor uses the label names you define and previous annotations to make it quicker and easier to label documents at scale with auto-labeling .
Custom extractor mechanisms You can create custom extractors that are specifically suited to your documents, and trained and evaluated with your data.
